name: mcp-agent
description: Builds agents from MCP servers using composable workflow patterns from the Building Effective Agents playbook, handling server lifecycle and tool routing.

skills.name: MCP Server Lifecycle
skills.description: Starts, connects and tears down MCP server connections so agent code never manages transports directly.

skills.name: Composable Workflow Patterns
skills.description: Implements routing, parallel fan-out, evaluator-optimizer and orchestrator-worker patterns as reusable classes.

skills.name: Tool Routing
skills.description: Routes a request to the right server and tool across many connected MCP servers based on intent.
